text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...T-that announcement just now. Means 『Scavenger Hunt,
4000m Obstacle Course』 already started...?

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
All right, Quiz round starting now! All participants,
please take positions!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, prepare to cheer! Match
Cheer Squad and raise voices loud!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on, Captain!
You okay with this!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Event already started. Our duty
right now is cheering runners right before--

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text:
But King-san, haven't you wanted to cheer
Kawakami-san this whole time!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: H-how did you know that...?

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
...C-could tell! Because
been watching you whole time...!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
Thought you were overbearing at first... but you kept
reaching out, encouraging us. Finally realized.

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san's uniform had 『S』 and 『P』...
Nature-san's uniform had 『N』 and 『N』...

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
Uniforms given to us by Captain had
our initials on them. Right from start, not
just Uma Musume being cheered--

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member B
text_block_list.text:
Worked hard helping us too,
always pushing us forward...!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text:
T-that's why our turn to be squad
you can be proud of! Please, go cheer
person you wanted to support most!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Isn't your voice trembling? Voice like that
just makes everyone worry instead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look, still first-rate Captain. Leaving you
here in this state would be irresponsible.

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about another first-rate
Captain stepping in!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Disciplinary Committee here to return lost banner!!
Plus, former Cheer Squad Captain, Bamboo Memory,
has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Eh, Bamboo-san...?
Why here...? And that outfit--

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Last year's uniform! Besides--

text_block_list.name: Pearl on the Phone
text_block_list.text:
『Hey! Bamboo, made it to gym!? Please.
Tell King! You'll handle cheering there!』

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When someone asks for help,
answering call is only right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh! Couldn't just stand by! Fine
if I jump in on cheering, right--!?

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, isn't that last year's Captain!?
Super loud voice~! Awesome surprise, looks fun-!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Member A
text_block_list.text:
...Captain, please!
Go!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Captain going to cheer along too!
Do your best-! Leave cheering here to us-!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching midpoint of 『Scavenger Hunt, 4000m Obstacle Course』!
No dropouts yet, but--

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~... Haaa~... Deyaaa~~~~!!
Taaaa~~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Guh... Haa... Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Cap-wearing Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looks totally exhausted.
Wonder if she can finish~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...W-will... finish this...
I... will--! ...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do not give up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, time to cheer! Tough moments
like this are when runners need support most!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Every single cheer reaches Uma Musume!
Unite feelings and voices as one! One, two.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray!!
Tr-a-ce-n!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Chair
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, hooray-. Hooray-?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sounding good! Next, raise voices louder and louder!
On count of 3, Hooray, Hooray! 1, 2, 3!

text_block_list.name: King & Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray!
Do-・Your-・Best-!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Keep same rhythm!
Hooray! Hooray!

text_block_list.name: King & Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Do-・ Your-・ Best-!
Hooray! Hooray! Do・Your・Best!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...DoooseeeeeeeEEy~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess charges forward again! One by one,
Uma Musume begin scaling hill!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Do your best-! Goooo, make it to top-!
Don't give up till finish!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Keep calling out! If unsure
on timing, just match me! One, two!

text_block_list.name: King & Spectators
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray! Tr-a-ce-n!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone reaches summit! All made it!! Final
stretch is scavenger hunt! Must run to goal
with item drawn by lottery!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-sa~~n! Your stole, need that stole!!
Item needed is 『Stole』!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh!? But stole is sewn into jacket!
Aaaah~ no helping it then~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Go take first place!!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh, run-!
Almost there, go for it everyone--!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right, fight on! Keep giving your all...!
Just a little further...!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(If you keep pushing forward,
then I shall keep cheering you on!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Cheering someone on who strives toward their goal,
who chases dreams with all their might—that is—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Supreme joy for any fan……!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gooooooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: TeeEEEryaaaaaaaaaa——!
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaa——……!)
